# 1 Enoch Chapter 35 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Watchers

---

**1** And after that I saw the other portals in the west at the ends of the great earth: three portals of heaven open there in the same manner as the former portals in the north.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Ge'ez text. Chapter 35 consists of a single verse — the briefest in 1 Enoch. It describes the western portals by analogy with the northern ones (ch. 34). The author clearly intends the same tripartite structure (one beneficent, two harmful) for the western direction as well. This verse forms the western section of the four-directional portal conclusion to the second cosmic journey.*
